description: This file implements the MetalContext class that manages Metal GPU resources, shader pipeline caching, device initialization, and context validation for Metal-based GPU computations within PyTorch's native ATen library.

classes.name: MetalContext
classes.description: A singleton class managing Metal GPU device, shader pipeline caching, and context validation for GPU-accelerated computations in PyTorch.

methods.name: sharedInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MetalContext, initializing device and resources if necessary.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if Metal is supported and properly configured on the current device.

methods.name: pipelineState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a compute pipeline state object for a given kernel shader.

methods.name: specializedPipelineState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a specialized compute pipeline state with specific constant values.

methods.name: emptyMTLBuffer
methods.description: Creates an empty Metal buffer of specified size.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a string description of the device, including device name and language version.

methods.name: sharedInstance
methods.description: Initializes and returns the singleton instance of MetaContext.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Performs device and feature support checks to determine if the GPU context is available.

methods.name: pipelineState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a compute pipeline state for the specified shader kernel.

methods.name: specializedPipelineState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a compute pipeline state with specific constant values for specialized shader execution.

methods.name: emptyMTLBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a new Metal buffer with the specified size.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string of the Metal device context.

methods.name: _compileProgram
methods.description: Compiles the Metal shader program, caching the resulting library.
